elements.name: Alex
elements.features: Lean, average build; head cropped out, so hair, facial hair, and glasses aren't visible.

voice.instructions: Use a mid-range pitch and conversational pace, with neutral American colouring, a clear, warm timbre, and relaxed, natural adult inflection.
voice.descriptor: Mid-range pitch, conversational pace, neutral American accent, and a clear, warm timbre with relaxed, natural inflection.
voice.why: Verse’s conversational male delivery best matches Alex’s mid-range pitch and relaxed warmth.
voice.sample_text: My name is Alex. Dawn light falls across a wooden table in the Morning Kitchen.

voice.instructions: Deliver with measured, unhurried pacing, calm clarity, a neutral American accent, and a mature adult tone with understated documentary authority.
voice.descriptor: a calm documentary narrator for this film: measured, clear, unhurried
voice.why: Sage’s calm, low register supports clear, composed documentary narration.
voice.sample_text: Wake up slow. A short film from the record.

fixtures.detail: A large rectangular dark wooden table with a thick top, broad apron and square legs; no chairs visible.
fixtures.name: Kitchen table

fixtures.detail: A broad white-framed window divided into two large panes, overlooking pale sky and a distant blue horizon.
fixtures.name: Window

fixtures.detail: A pale roller blind gathered along the top of the window.
fixtures.name: Window blind

fixtures.detail: Cream panelled base cupboards and drawers with small metal handles beneath a pale grey worktop.
fixtures.name: Left base cabinets and worktop

fixtures.detail: Cream base cupboards and drawers beneath a continuous pale worktop running below the window.
fixtures.name: Rear base cabinets and worktop

fixtures.detail: Cream panelled cupboards and a drawer beneath a pale worktop beside the cooker.
fixtures.name: Right base cabinets and worktop

fixtures.detail: Partially cropped cream wall cabinets with small handles and a dark open recess.
fixtures.name: Left wall cabinets

fixtures.detail: Cream wall cabinets with small knobs, with a dark open recess at the far right.
fixtures.name: Right wall cabinets

fixtures.detail: A shallow sink set into the worktop below the window, with an upright metal tap.
fixtures.name: Sink and tap

fixtures.detail: A white freestanding cooker with a dark glass oven door, front controls and a dark hob.
fixtures.name: Cooker

fixtures.detail: A dark electric kettle on the worktop.
fixtures.name: Kettle

fixtures.detail: Pale countertop containers, including a holder containing upright wooden utensils.
fixtures.name: Countertop containers and utensils

fixtures.detail: A pale cylindrical holder containing several utensils, beside a partially cropped reflective metal vessel.
fixtures.name: Utensil holder and metal vessel

fixtures.detail: Several small pale and tan containers grouped near the right end of the window ledge.
fixtures.name: Window-ledge containers

fixtures.detail: A small round blue-green decorative object mounted beside the window.
fixtures.name: Round wall decoration

morning-kitchen.light: Strong, soft morning daylight enters through the large rear window, making the exterior very bright and leaving the table and nearer cabinetry in subdued shadow. No artificial light fixture is visible.
morning-kitchen.floor: Square muted terracotta-brown floor tiles laid in a straight grid with visible grout lines.
morning-kitchen.walls: Plain warm cream painted upper walls with a pale grey-white square-tiled backsplash above the worktops.
